# FlowsToken Desktop 0.7.4
<!-- release-status: unreleased -->

## English

### New

- Git workspace import, session management with search and batch actions, SSH password login, custom top-bar buttons, release notes viewer, 10 app icons, and chat bubble styles.
- Workspaces for grouping projects with Ctrl+1~9 switching; Git branch status, open-canvas entry, and collapsible question panel in top bar; macOS Dock badge showing pending sessions.
- Launcher quick panel (⌘T) pinning active sessions; Settings adds Usage statistics by day/model, token ticket sharing, and Vetta Vivi pet controls; plugin API 2.9.0 with top-bar actions and steppers.
- Design gallery pre-renders covers on scroll; large conversations and files over 100KB stream and preview smoothly without UI lag; Git diffs render virtually in milliseconds.

### Fixes

- Fixed window zoom reset on macOS after reopening, reasoning-model menu closing, terminal renderer errors on session switch, Git tab state anomalies, design canvas first-frame flash, and chat scrollbar clipping.

### Upgrade notes

- Double-tap modifier quick panel replaced by the Launcher (⌘T); legacy quickPanel settings ignored. Desktop pet holiday bubbles and cultivation achievement themes removed; Vivi uses default themed bubble.

## 中文

### 新增

- Git 仓库一键导入项目；会话管理面板支持搜索与批量操作；SSH 远程主机支持加密密码登录；顶栏支持自定义按钮排序与版本介绍查看器；外观新增 10 款应用图标与聊天气泡样式。
- 新增「工作空间」分组管理项目与会话并支持 Ctrl+1~9 快速切换；顶栏集成 Git 分支状态、打开画布入口与可折叠提问面板；macOS Dock 图标显示待处理会话角标。
- 新增「启动器」快捷面板（⌘T）置顶进行中会话；设置新增按天/模型统计的「用量」页与小票分享、Vivi 桌宠控制；插件 API 升级至 2.9.0 支持顶栏富操作与步进器。
- 设计画廊滚动时预渲染封面图提升流畅度；长会话与超过 100KB 的大文件采用增量解析与轻量查看器不卡顿；Git 大文件 diff 虚拟化渲染达毫秒级。

### 修复

- 修复 macOS 重开窗口缩放档位回退、推理模型选择关闭菜单、切换会话终端渲染报错、Git 页签状态异常、设计画布首帧错显与滚动条裁切等问题。

### 升级注意

- 双击功能键快捷面板移除并统一改用「启动器」（⌘T），旧版 quickPanel 配置忽略；桌宠节日气泡与修仙成就主题移除，Vivi 恢复默认主题气泡。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Jack2099/flowstoken-desktop/compare/v0.7.3...v0.7.4
